retrievalProfile.description: A three-person portrait featuring high-contrast studio lighting, voluminous 80s hairstyles, and a combination of ultra-wide geometric sans-serif and vibrant neon script typography.
triggerTerms: glamour portrait with saturated fabric wraps

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, triangular composition of three women with dramatic 80s styling, set against a dark background with bold, contrasting typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between dark background and saturated clothing colors
Juxtaposition of rigid geometric type and fluid script
High-key facial lighting against deep shadows
coreInvariants: Vibrant pink handwritten script overlaying the main title
Saturated color-blocked fabric wraps (orange, teal, pink)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a close-up, overlapping triangular formation filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central subject's face, framed by the two flanking subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold yellow title in the top right, down through the script, then circling through the three faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space concentrated in the upper left and behind the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black background providing high contrast for subjects.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Saturated primary and secondary hues in clothing (Orange, Teal, Magenta).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for primary display type and hot pink for script.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in clothing and type against a low-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-extended geometric sans-serif and expressive brush script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary type: Extremely wide horizontal proportions, thick uniform strokes, square terminals.
Secondary type: Fluid, slanted cursive with varying line weight and sharp flourishes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: E and X in primary type feature elongated horizontal bars.
Script features long, sweeping descenders and ascenders.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid, wide geometric forms and organic, slanted handwriting.

preserve: Horizontal stretch of the main title
Vibrant pink color of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, wide geometric structure of the primary title.
Captures the energetic, 80s-style brush script feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three women with 80s hairstyles (perm, feathered blonde, short dark bob) wearing saturated orange, teal, and pink fabric wraps against a black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ultra-extended yellow sans-serif title in the top right. Overlay a smaller hot pink brush script subtitle slightly below and overlapping the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the main title horizontally stretched?
Is the script text hot pink and slanted?
Are the three subjects arranged in a tight triangular crop?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow text is significantly wider than it is tall.
Ensure the pink script is legible but expressive.
Verify the subjects' eyes are all directed toward the camera.
Confirm the color blocking of the clothes is distinct and vibrant.
recipe.reuseFormula: Triangular portrait + Black background + Extended Sans + Neon Script = 80s Pop Aesthetic
